# unifi_countries (Data Source)

Lists the country/code definitions known to the controller via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only and site-independent. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the country/code definitions known to the controller (Official API).
data "unifi_countries" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing countries.

### Read-Only

- `countries` (Attributes List) The country definitions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries))

<a id="nestedatt--countries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `name` (String) The country name.
